description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gorakgahamada, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620075
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 78 and 79) with detailed property particulars including ownership details, extent, class of title, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
